pull_request.title: feat(policy): add path-aware contracts
pull_request.body:
## Summary
This change adds a generic path-aware maintainer policy engine for pull requests.

Fixes #17

## Validation
- [x] Unit tests run
- [x] Threat model reviewed

## Security impact
The parser reads event metadata and local Git history without executing repository source.

## AI assistance
AI assisted with test design; the generated output was reviewed and executed locally.
